description: This PHP class 'ProjectReportData' is part of the OrangeHRM time reporting module. It implements the 'ReportData' interface and provides methods to generate project activity report data and associated metadata based on a set of search/filter parameters. The class uses traits for helper functions related to dates, numbers, and project services, and integrates with other parts of the OrangeHRM system to fetch, process, and normalize project report data.

classes.name: ProjectReportData
classes.description: Implements report data generation for project activity reports within the OrangeHRM time management module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with filtering parameters for the report.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates a normalized array of project activity report data based on current filter parameters.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the report, including total duration, count, and project details.
